name: Open-Source Microservices Benchmark Suite
description: Cloud services have recently started undergoing a major shift from monolithic applications, to graphs of hundreds or thousands of loosely-coupled microservices. Microservices fundamentally change a lot of assumptions current cloud systems are designed with, and present both opportunities and challenges when optimizing for quality of service (QoS) and cloud utilization.
notes: Systems benchmark (non-LLM) focused on microservice performance; requires deployment and workload generation infrastructure; results are sensitive to environment/configuration and not a small static dataset.
